names.name: The Ukok Plateau
names.said: Altai, Siberia — where the ice kept a tattooed shoulder for 2,400 years

text.what: The high plateau on the Russian–Chinese–Mongolian frontier where frozen Pazyryk burials preserved tattooed skin.
text.story: Water got into the burial chamber through a robber's shaft, froze, and sealed everything inside a block of ice under stone and permafrost. Clothing, wood, horses and skin came out of it.
